name: KY-03
label: Safe D

key_factors: Louisville-based district with a strong Democratic lean (D+10 PVI)
Incumbent Morgan McGarvey running with a large fundraising edge ($1.8M on hand)

model.rationale: The fundamentals point strongly to McGarvey: a D+10 district, incumbency, and a dominant fundraising position against a challenger with no visible financial support. Markets price this as effectively decided, so the forecast stays close to the baseline.
model.watch: Any polling showing a much tighter race, or significant outside spending for Rodriquez, would be the first sign of movement.
notes: No expert rater lists this race; treated as safe for the party holding the seat.
No usable general-election polls; forecast rests on fundamentals and expert ratings.

overview:
Morgan McGarvey seeks a third term in this Louisville-based House district, which leans Democratic by about ten points on the partisan baseline. He enters the race with a substantial financial advantage, having raised over $1.6 million and holding $1.8 million on hand, while Republican challenger Maria Rodriquez reports no fundraising figures. No public polls or expert race ratings are available for this contest.

Prediction markets give McGarvey roughly a 96 percent chance of winning, consistent with the district's fundamentals. With no evidence of a competitive challenge, the race is rated Safe Democratic, though the absence of polling leaves some room for uncertainty about the exact margin.
